name: Felipe Solferini
biography: Felipe is a senior penetration tester and self-proclaimed security researcher. Most of the time, he’s mashing the wrong buttons, hoping for the worst but expecting the best - or just YOLOing like there’s no tomorrow. Occasionally, he wonders if life is just a CTF. He has presented his research at BSides London, BSides Sofia, and Bsides Vilnius.
